title: Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Pitavastatin and Pravastatin in Elderly Patients

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety of pitavastatin with that of pravastatin in elderly patients

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in LDL-C. timeframe=Baseline to 12 weeks. Pitavastatin 1 mg=-31.43 (±11.833); Pravastatin 10 mg=-22.41 (±14.051); Pitavastatin 2 mg=-38.99 (±13.069)
